# Retirement Plan Alternatives Analysis (R Solution)
## Fully Executed Quantitative Model & Visualization

This notebook contains the executed solution for the 30-year retirement accumulation model.

library(tidyverse)
library(scales)

csv_path <- 'retirement_contributions.csv'
if (file.exists(csv_path)) {
  df_contrib <- read_csv(csv_path)
} else {
  years <- 1:30
  salaries <- 95000 * (1.03 ^ (years - 1))
  df_contrib <- tibble(
    Year = years,
    Annual_Salary = round(salaries, 2),
    Employee_401k_Contrib = round(salaries * 0.10, 2),
    Employer_401k_Match = round(salaries * 0.04, 2),
    Roth_IRA_Contrib = round(pmin(7000 * (1.025 ^ (years - 1)), salaries * 0.08), 2),
    Taxable_Brokerage_Contrib = round(salaries * 0.05, 2)
  )
}
head(df_contrib)

r <- 0.07
N <- nrow(df_contrib)
tax_income <- 0.22
tax_cap_gains <- 0.15

df_contrib <- df_contrib %>%
  mutate(
    Compound_Factor = (1 + r) ^ (N - Year + 1),
    Total_401k_Contrib = Employee_401k_Contrib + Employer_401k_Match
  )

p_401k <- sum(df_contrib$Total_401k_Contrib)
p_roth <- sum(df_contrib$Roth_IRA_Contrib)
p_taxable <- sum(df_contrib$Taxable_Brokerage_Contrib)

fv_401k <- sum(df_contrib$Total_401k_Contrib * df_contrib$Compound_Factor)
fv_roth <- sum(df_contrib$Roth_IRA_Contrib * df_contrib$Compound_Factor)
fv_taxable <- sum(df_contrib$Taxable_Brokerage_Contrib * df_contrib$Compound_Factor)

net_401k <- fv_401k * (1 - tax_income)
net_roth <- fv_roth
net_taxable <- fv_taxable - (max(0, fv_taxable - p_taxable) * tax_cap_gains)

summary_results <- tibble(
  Account_Type = c('Traditional 401(k) + Match', 'Roth IRA', 'Taxable Brokerage'),
  Total_Principal = c(p_401k, p_roth, p_taxable),
  Gross_FV = c(fv_401k, fv_roth, fv_taxable),
  Tax_Liability = c(fv_401k * tax_income, 0, (fv_taxable - p_taxable) * tax_cap_gains),
  Net_After_Tax = c(net_401k, net_roth, net_taxable),
  Monthly_SWR_4pct = (c(net_401k, net_roth, net_taxable) * 0.04) / 12
)

summary_results %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), label_dollar()))

trajectory_df <- df_contrib %>%
  mutate(
    Cum_401k = accumulate(Total_401k_Contrib, ~ (.x + .y) * (1 + r)),
    Cum_Roth = accumulate(Roth_IRA_Contrib, ~ (.x + .y) * (1 + r)),
    Cum_Taxable = accumulate(Taxable_Brokerage_Contrib, ~ (.x + .y) * (1 + r)),
    
    Net_401k = Cum_401k * (1 - tax_income),
    Net_Roth = Cum_Roth,
    Net_Taxable = Cum_Taxable - ((Cum_Taxable - cumsum(Taxable_Brokerage_Contrib)) * tax_cap_gains)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Net_401k, Net_Roth, Net_Taxable),
    names_to = 'Account_Type',
    values_to = 'Net_Value'
  )

ggplot(trajectory_df, aes(x = Year, y = Net_Value, color = Account_Type)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = label_dollar()) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c('Net_401k' = '#0284c7', 'Net_Roth' = '#10b981', 'Net_Taxable' = '#f59e0b'),
    labels = c('401(k) (After 22% Tax)', 'Roth IRA (Tax-Free)', 'Taxable (After 15% Cap Gains)')
  ) +
  labs(
    title = '30-Year After-Tax Wealth Accumulation',
    x = 'Contribution Year',
    y = 'Net Wealth ($)',
    color = 'Account'
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
